title: Laredo City Council Meets Tonight: Utilities Report, Federal Project Talks, Scooter Rules on Agenda
excerpt: The Laredo City Council is meeting tonight at City Hall, with a proposed monthly utilities performance report, a resolution on the proposed federal infrastructure project, and rules for electric scooters and bicycles on the agenda.
content:
The Laredo City Council is meeting tonight at City Hall Council Chambers, 1110 Houston St., the City of Laredo announced Monday evening.

Among the items on the agenda is the proposed creation of a monthly Utilities Performance & Accountability Report, according to the city.

Council members are also set to discuss a resolution requesting state intervention in ongoing negotiations regarding the proposed federal infrastructure project, according to the city.

Potential regulations to promote the safe operation of electric scooters and bicycles throughout Laredo are also on the agenda, according to the city.

Residents can watch the meeting live on the City of Laredo's Facebook page, on YouTube at @PublicAccessChannel1984, or on Spectrum Channel 1300, according to the city.

Source: City of Laredo - Government, November 16, 2026.
